name: Biomancer's Familiar
clause: Activated abilities of creatures you control cost {2} less to activate. This effect can't reduce the mana in that cost to less than one mana. / {T}: The next time target creature adapts this turn, it adapts as though it had no +1/+1 counters on it.

needs.proposedSignature: StaticEffect { kind: 'ability-cost-alter', amount: Amount, more?: true, who?: 'you' | 'opponent' | 'any', filter?: Filter, abilityKind?: 'activated' | 'mana' | 'loyalty', floorMana?: number }
needs.semantics: Change what ACTIVATED abilities of matching permanents cost to activate, with an optional floor ('This effect can't reduce the mana in that cost to less than one mana'). Today `cost-alter` (src/engine/ops/cost-alter.ts) and the core `cost-adjust` static only alter the cost of a SPELL being cast — they are folded into the cast payment plans legal.ts enumerates — and nothing at all touches the cost of activating an ability, so 'Activated abilities of creatures you control cost {2} less to activate' has no expression. The floor is part of the same effect because CR 601.2f/118.7 apply it after every reduction, not per reduction.
needs.clause: Activated abilities of creatures you control cost {2} less to activate. This effect can't reduce the mana in that cost to less than one mana.

needs.proposedSignature: Effect { op: 'adapt-ignoring-counters', target: TargetSpec, times?: number, duration: 'eot' }  // or the general form { op: 'keyword-action-replacement', action: 'adapt', target, ignoreCounters: true, times: 1, duration: 'eot' }
needs.semantics: Adapt N (CR 702.131a) does nothing if the creature already has a +1/+1 counter on it. This effect makes the next N adaptations of a target creature this turn behave as though it had no +1/+1 counters, i.e. it is a replacement effect over a later keyword action. The `adapt` EFFECT exists in the keyword-action family, but nothing can modify how a later adapt resolves, and no Ref survives from an activated ability to a keyword action performed afterwards by a different source.
needs.clause: {T}: The next time target creature adapts this turn, it adapts as though it had no +1/+1 counters on it.
